text:
Alex G: Morning — quick sync on IAM/KMS work. What I did: ran a KMS rotation dry-run in staging and fixed a perm bug in the mirroring script. Blockers: staging decrypt tests intermittently hitting 403. Today: coordinate a short-lived admin binding and re-run full suite. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/432 :eyes:

Maria L: Saw the 403s earlier. Can you paste the exact error?

Alex G: ```2026-03-15T08:12:03Z error: kms: decrypt failed status=403 resource=projects/redwood/keys/rw-key msg='Token expired'```

Cheng W: Looks like the test harness STS token TTL is too short. I can bump the runner TTL or create a delegated SA binding. Also note the dry-run should call `kms-rotate --principal iam:serviceAccount:infra-test@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` not the default cluster SA.

DevOps Bot: deploy: infra/test-runner finished rollout at 2026-03-15T08:20:32Z — 1/1 instances updated :white_check_mark:

Sam R: Added a unit test that simulates rotation + token refresh in PR 433: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/433 — pinged @Alex G for review.

Priya S: Compliance flag: retention for rotation/audit logs needs to be 90 days per policy. Please ensure audit config and S3 forwarding are included in the PR.

Alex G: Ack. Where should the retention config live? I remember something about an audit configmap.

Priya S: Add `audit.log.retention_days=90` to the platform configmap and forward to s3://redwood-audit-90d. I'll approve once the config is in the PR.

Alex G: Blocking ask: need a KMS admin binding for infra-test to complete the dry-run. @Cheng W can you create a short-lived `roles/cloudkms.admin` binding for the service account or suggest an alternative?

Cheng W: I won't grant blanket admin, but I can add a time-limited binding for the infra-test SA for 1h window. Will post the exact command after I create it.

Cheng W: (command I'll run) `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding infra-test@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member='serviceAccount:infra-test@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.admin' --condition=None --quiet` — will use a time-limited approach via a temporary token in practice.

Alex G: Great, thanks. If that clears the 403s I'll rerun the full suite and merge PRs 432 + 433. Quick reviewer ping: @Sam R @Maria L, can you glance at 432 today? :pray:

Maria L: On it — aiming to review by 12:30pm.

Sam R: I can do a pass after lunch. If you hit any more 403s ping me and I'll look at the test harness token refresh code. :thumbsup:

Alex G: Perfect — I'll post follow-up once the short-lived binding is live and after the re-run. Thanks everyone.
